div.style: color: rgb(11, 31, 58) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(58, 47, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
HONEST GAP 1 - RBAC is advisory on the server.
Capability codes such as manage_borrowing are seeded, attached to roles
and returned to the SPA, but no server-side check reads them. The only
capabilities the backend enforces are backup.manage_own and
backup.view_all. Real server-side authorisation is is_staff plus
is_demo_account.

div.style: color: rgb(58, 47, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
HONEST GAP 2 - unguarded write endpoints.
RegionViewSet, LocationViewSet, EquipmentCategoryViewSet,
EquipmentKitViewSet and InventoryCheckViewSet declare no
permission_classes, so they inherit IsAuthenticated. Any logged-in user
can create or delete a category or a location, while Equipment itself is
admin-only.

div.style: color: rgb(58, 47, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Two independent rate limiters.
The middleware buckets by user id or client IP into the DatabaseCache
alias rate_limit, so the count is shared across gunicorn workers. The
@rate_limit decorator on extend, export_records and
send_overdue_notifications uses the default LocMemCache, which is per
worker process. Client IP comes from CF-Connecting-IP first, then
X-Forwarded-For only when TRUST_X_FORWARDED_FOR is on.

svg.text: Authorization model - four independent layers, and where RBAC stops
